# Online-Therapy.com

> > A comprehensive online mental health platform offering CBT-based therapy, couples counseling, and wellness resources with verified therapists across multiple countries.

Online-Therapy.com provides accessible mental health treatment through cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) delivered by licensed therapists. The platform serves individual clients, couples, and corporate organizations with evidence-based therapeutic approaches and supplementary wellness resources.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Online therapy platform
- Couples therapy
- Mental health treatment
- Therapist directory
- Mental wellness
- Individual therapy
- Corporate mental health
- Meditation and yoga

- Remote therapy
- Therapy subscription plans
- Dr. Steven Gans

## Core Services

- [Online Therapy That Works - Start Getting Happier Now!](https://www.online-therapy.com): Homepage showcasing online therapy services with CBT approach and therapist testimonials.
- [How it works](https://www.online-therapy.com/how_it_works.php): Explains platform features and CBT-based treatment approach with subscription details.
- [Couples therapy for a new you | Online Couples Therapy](https://www.online-therapy.com/couples.php): Dedicated couples therapy service with relationship counseling tools and conflict resolution.
- [Online Therapy for Employees! | Businesses and Organizations](https://www.online-therapy.com/business.php): B2B service offering employee wellness and corporate mental health benefits programs.
- [Yoga and Meditation](https://www.online-therapy.com/yoga-and-meditation): Free yoga and meditation videos including 7-Days of Yoga as wellness program resource.

## Therapist Directory & Profiles

- [Find a Therapist in Your Region - Verified and Experienced Professionals](https://www.online-therapy.com/therapist): Therapist directory with regional search across Australia, Canada, UK, and other countries.
- [Dr. Steven Gans (MD), MA, USA | Online-Therapy.com](https://www.online-therapy.com/therapist/steven-gans): Therapist profile for Dr. Steven Gans from Harvard Medical School and McLean Hospital.
- [Dr. Elizabeth Lombardo (PhD), IL, USA | Online-Therapy.com](https://www.online-therapy.com/therapist/elizabeth-lombardo): Therapist profile for Dr. Elizabeth Lombardo specializing in CBT and stress/anxiety treatment.
